channel.name: Codie Sanchez
channel.blurb: Cash flow over hype. Codie Sanchez builds wealth by buying boring businesses, mastering sales, fixing money habits and thinking contrarian — plus interviews from her BigDeal podcast. The wealth-building complement to theMITmonk.

note: Concept summaries and value ratings are AI-generated digests to help you find the right video fast — not financial advice. Do your own due diligence before any money decision. View counts are as of the last refresh.

videos.title: Do This Every Time You Get Paid (Paycheck Routine)
videos.summary: A step-by-step routine for what to do with every paycheck — how to split income across saving, investing and spending so wealth builds automatically instead of leaking away.
videos.takeaway: Automate where your money goes the moment it lands.

videos.title: How To DESTROY Negative Thoughts (And Rewire Your Brain) | Tony Robbins
videos.summary: Tony Robbins on the BigDeal podcast: how to interrupt negative thought patterns, rewire your mental defaults, and build the psychology that high performers and wealth-builders run on.
videos.takeaway: Your mental patterns set the ceiling on your results.

videos.title: How To Speak Like The Richest 1%
videos.summary: The language and speaking patterns of the wealthy — how word choice, framing and confidence signal status and move money in conversations and negotiations.
videos.takeaway: How you speak about money shapes how much of it you make.

videos.title: The Psychology of Making Money
videos.summary: The mental models and beliefs that separate people who build wealth from those who don't — reframing your relationship with money, risk and self-worth.
videos.takeaway: Wealth is a mindset problem before it's a math problem.

videos.title: Everything They Teach You At Goldman Sachs
videos.summary: The money and career lessons taught inside Goldman Sachs, distilled for everyone else — how the financial elite think about leverage, risk and getting ahead.
videos.takeaway: Learn how the financial elite think, then apply it on your scale.

videos.title: Charisma Expert: 5 Ways To Project Confidence (Even When You Don't Feel It) | Dr. Shadé Zahrai
videos.summary: Dr. Shadé Zahrai on projecting confidence and charisma on demand — practical cues for presence and influence that translate directly into business and negotiations.
videos.takeaway: Confidence is a set of signals you can practice and project.

videos.title: If I Wanted to Become a Millionaire on a 9-5 Salary, I'd Do This
videos.summary: A concrete plan to reach millionaire status on a regular salary — controlling expenses, investing consistently, and adding leverage on the side without quitting your job.
videos.takeaway: A 9-5 plus discipline and leverage can still build a fortune.

videos.title: 4 Steps to Become a Sales Machine (Make a TON of Money) | Shelby Sapp
videos.summary: A four-step sales system with Shelby Sapp — finding prospects, handling objections and closing — framed as the highest-leverage skill for making money fast.
videos.takeaway: Sales is the most transferable money-making skill there is.

videos.title: You Don't Need To Start A Business, Just Buy One Of These
videos.summary: Codie's signature thesis: instead of starting from zero, buy an existing cash-flowing 'boring' business. Which kinds to look for and why acquisition beats founding for most people.
videos.takeaway: Buying a proven business beats betting on a brand-new one.

videos.title: How To Grow Your Business SO Fast It Feels Illegal
videos.summary: Aggressive but practical levers to scale a business fast — systems, offers and distribution moves that compound revenue once the fundamentals are in place.
videos.takeaway: Growth comes from a few high-leverage levers, pulled hard.

videos.title: How to Outwork Everyone By Doing 1% Better
videos.summary: Why marginal, 1%-better effort compounds into a decisive edge over time — outworking others through consistency rather than bursts of intensity.
videos.takeaway: Tiny consistent edges compound into an unfair advantage.

videos.title: 7 Habits That Made Me Rich (But They're Weird)
videos.summary: Seven unconventional habits Codie credits for building her wealth — counterintuitive routines around money, time and decisions that most people never adopt.
videos.takeaway: Weird, deliberate habits beat conventional busywork.

videos.title: How to Get Ahead of 99% of People (Starting Today)
videos.summary: The handful of moves that put you ahead of almost everyone — focusing on rare, valuable skills and acting while others hesitate.
videos.takeaway: Most people don't act — that's your opening.

videos.title: A Doer Will Always Outperform A Thinker
videos.summary: A case for action over endless analysis — why people who ship and iterate beat those who only plan, especially in business and wealth-building.
videos.takeaway: Bias toward action; you learn by doing, not deliberating.

videos.title: How To ACTUALLY Make Money Using AI
videos.summary: Practical, non-hype ways to turn AI into real income — the services, products and efficiencies you can monetize now rather than chasing trends.
videos.takeaway: Monetize AI by solving a paid problem, not by chasing hype.

videos.title: How to Be More Successful Than 99% of People | Malcolm Gladwell
videos.summary: Malcolm Gladwell on the BigDeal podcast: the real drivers of outsized success — practice, timing, environment and the myths we believe about talent.
videos.takeaway: Success is built from practice and timing, not just talent.

videos.title: Ex-Amazon VP: Lessons from Working with Jeff Bezos that Changed My Life | Ethan Evans
videos.summary: Former Amazon VP Ethan Evans shares hard-won leadership and career lessons from working alongside Jeff Bezos — decision-making, ownership and how the best operators think.
videos.takeaway: Think like an owner and decisions get sharper.

videos.title: 3 Rules For Selling To Rich People (Make A TON of Money)
videos.summary: Three rules for selling to wealthy clients — how their buying psychology differs and how to position offers for higher-value, higher-margin deals.
videos.takeaway: Selling to the wealthy is about trust and positioning, not pressure.
